newsitem.title: CANADA: UP Resources confirms suing Redaurum.
newsitem.headline: UP Resources confirms suing Redaurum.

text.p: Union Pacific Resources Group Inc confirmed on Friday it filed a lawsuit against Redaurum Ltd.
"We are suing them, but that's all I can say," Union Pacific Resources spokesman Mark Knouse said in a phone interview from the company's head office in Fort Worth, Texas.
Legal documents showed UP Resources was claiming mineral rights to Redaurum's Kelsey Lake diamond mine in Colorado.
The suit also named Diamond Co NL, an Australian company operating mainly in Colorado.
The suit was filed on Friday in Colorado, Knouse said.
UP Resources claimed the rights stemmed from a document from 1896, which gave the rights to United Pacific Railway Co and its successors.
UP Resources was spun off from Union Pacific Corp last October.
Redaurum said earlier today it had reports that Union Pacific launched a lawsuit.
Redaurum had not yet been served with the suit, the company's chief executive, Tony Hamilton, said in a phone interview.
He said Redaurum owns 100 percent of the Kelsey Lake mine.
"They're claiming mineral rights to the mine, which they have no right to," Hamilton said.
"Whatever it is they're up to, we will defend ourselves," Hamilton said, adding there was no question to Redaurum's title to the property.
